reasons.AGE_WITHIN_LIMIT: Your age is within the required limit.
reasons.AGE_OVER_LIMIT: Your age exceeds the maximum limit for this post.
reasons.AGE_BELOW_MINIMUM: Your age is below the minimum age required for this post.
reasons.AGE_OVER_LIMIT_RELAXATION_POSSIBLE: Your age exceeds the general limit, but a relaxation may apply based on your category. Please enter your category.
reasons.AGE_MISSING_DOB: Date of birth is required to check the age criterion.
reasons.QUAL_MET: Your qualification meets or exceeds the required level.
reasons.QUAL_BELOW_REQUIRED: Your qualification level is below the required level for this post.
reasons.QUAL_STREAM_MISMATCH: Your qualification stream does not match the required stream for this post.
reasons.QUAL_MISSING: Qualification information is required to check this criterion.
reasons.CATEGORY_NOT_ENTERED: Your category was not entered. Category information is needed to check relaxation eligibility.
reasons.CATEGORY_RELAXATION_APPLIED: Category relaxation was successfully applied to your profile.
reasons.CATEGORY_RELAXATION_NOT_APPLICABLE: No category relaxation is available for your category under this notice.
reasons.EQUIV_CLAUSE_AMBIGUOUS: The equivalents clause in the notice is ambiguous. Check with the issuing authority.
reasons.CORRIGENDUM_PENDING: A corrigendum has been issued for this notice. Rules may have changed. Check the latest version.
reasons.RULE_AMBIGUOUS: This rule in the notice is ambiguous and cannot be evaluated automatically.
